name: 福昕阅读器 (Foxit Reader, China edition)
vendor: 福建福昕软件开发股份有限公司

summary.en: Chinese edition of Foxit's PDF reader. Linaro's Works on WoA data lists it as native Arm64, validated by Qualcomm and NVIDIA.
summary.zh-TW: 福昕的中國大陸版 PDF 閱讀器。Linaro 的 Works on WoA 資料列為原生 Arm64，並經 Qualcomm 與 NVIDIA 驗證。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Vendor page could not be read from this environment; the result rests on the Linaro catalog alone.
caveats.zh-TW: 此環境無法讀取原廠頁面，結果僅依據 Linaro 目錄。
